effects.actual_behavior: Registered lm_jigsaw codec allows depth0..40/range1..500, rejects range+terrainAdaptation12>500 (NONE0). Stored pool_aliases, dimension_padding and liquid_settings decoded with defaults empty/ZERO/APPLY_WATERLOGGING, but custom findGenerationPoint calls LMJigsawPlacement ignoring these stored options. Root Rotation.NONE, random pool element/named jigsaw, centers initial XZ bounding box via integer half-span, optional first-free heightmap plus sampled height; subtract ground delta. Root included at depth0. Bounds center +/-maxDistance (+1 upper); subtract root AABB from free shape. Child queue breadth-first, native jigsaw attachment/pool fallback/shuffled rotations; rigid versus terrain projection, expansion hack extends short piece maxsize+1, collision with AABB.deflate(.25) against free shape only, subtract accepted boxes and build junctions; all custom pieces force IGNORE_WATERLOGGING. generateJigsaw helper uses256 and directly places built pieces, but no packaged external producer. Registered cp_kingdom codec findGenerationPoint instead calls vanilla JigsawPlacement with aliases/padding/liquid options; shipped collapsed_kingdom resource uses lm_jigsaw, so the separate unused custom CollapsedKingdomJigsawPlacement is not selected. StructureUtils settings retain biome/spawn override/step/terrain arguments. ModBuiltInStructures unqualified shulker_tower key resolves minecraft namespace in datagen-only helper, not shipped structure ID. NoWaterInStructureProcessor returns input unchanged; nonempty-fluid block in center WorldGenRegion chunk and minY<=Y<=maxY schedules its block tick0; no explicit fluid removal. Loaded StructureTemplateMixin HEAD placeInWorld exact signature scans processor type through accessor; when NO_WATER_PROCESSOR present, forces IGNORE_WATERLOGGING, without canceling placement. Native template entity/BE resource payloads are reviewed independently; name does not prove attack or water destruction.
